description: A contemporaneous report establishes a Mohéli gathering and dispersal on 28 Oct, but no count or estimate of simultaneous participants. All-island shop closure is not gathering attendance; the candidate remains pending_threshold.
required_followup: Seek a separate contemporary report, organizer/union statement, image or official record giving the gathering’s simultaneous attendance.

description: The gathering opposed a tax imposed by Société comorienne des ports and the governor negotiated, but the contemporaneous source does not establish that the tax was own-state policy. A search-only 1995 law refers to state-held participation in SOCOPOTRAM, while a search-only 2014 gazette item refers to SCP creation; neither establishes identity or SCP ownership in 2024.
required_followup: Find an authoritative record of SCP’s status and a source specifying the demand’s intended government/policy target.

description: The Oct 28 report says activities resumed on Oct 29; a Nov 4 issue describes a Nov 1 few-hour strike as the end of an indefinite strike. Whether the reports are one continuing episode or separate stoppages remains unresolved.
required_followup: Compare additional contemporary reporting around Oct 29–Nov 1, organizer statements and any reported pause/end.

description: Five captured open-web searches cover French/English broad terms, an Arabic month search and a French Mohéli follow-up. Shikomori search was not systematic; LexisNexis-equivalent newspaper archives and full local radio/print archives were unavailable. One 2025 false-positive lead was verified out of period. No claim of month exhaustiveness.
required_followup: Coordinator/reviewer may search local Shikomori-language and island press/broadcast archives and other contemporaneous sources.
